decks.notes: The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to maintain board control through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures like Spellstutter Sprite. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent by trading efficiently and generating card advantage with cards like Brainstorm and Augur of Bolas. Additionally, the deck can generate a quick clock with evasive creatures like Ninja of the Deep Hours and Murmuring Mystic. The deck also includes a few utility lands like Bojuka Bog and Dimir Aqueduct to disrupt graveyard strategies and provide additional value.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by using gates to ramp up mana and cards like Counterspell and Brainstorm to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes a mix of creatures like Dawnbringer Cleric and Guardian of the Guildpact to provide additional defense and win conditions. By carefully managing resources and utilizing the synergy between gates and control elements, the deck aims to outlast opponents and emerge victorious in the Pauper format.

This deck focuses on using cheap artifacts to boost the power of creatures and overwhelm the opponent quickly. By using cards like All That Glitters and Moon-Circuit Hacker, along with efficient card draw like Thoughtcast and Of One Mind, the deck aims to establish a strong board presence early on. The inclusion of cards like Springleaf Drum and Metallic Rebuke provide additional utility and disruption, allowing the deck to maintain pressure while also disrupting the opponent's game plan. The synergy between artifacts and creature cards is crucial for achieving a fast and powerful win condition.

The deck focuses on fast and aggressive plays using artifacts and creatures with affinity for artifacts. By quickly ramping up mana with cards like Springleaf Drum and Ancient Den, the deck can deploy powerful threats like Myr Enforcer and Ornithopter early in the game. Cards like Metallic Rebuke and All That Glitters give the deck additional ways to protect its creatures and pump them up for lethal attacks. This allows the deck to overwhelm opponents quickly and efficiently, while also having some card draw and disruption options to maintain momentum.

The deck focuses on quickly buffing up creatures with auras to deal large amounts of damage to the opponent. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of low-cost creatures like Gladecover Scout and Slippery Bogle, along with powerful enchantments like Ethereal Armor, Rancor, and Ancestral Mask. The deck also includes cards like Utopia Sprawl and Abundant Growth to fix mana and ensure consistent plays. By efficiently utilizing auras and enchantments, this deck can quickly build up formidable threats and secure a victory through aggressive plays.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy through a combination of counter spells, card draw, and removal. By utilizing cards like Brainstorm, Counterspell, and Snuff Out, the deck aims to control the game and prevent the opponent from executing their game plan effectively. Additionally, the deck includes powerful threats like Gurmag Angler and Cryptic Serpent to apply pressure and close out the game once control has been established. It also includes some unexpected elements like Unexpected Fangs and Lórien Revealed to catch the opponent off guard.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's actions by using a combination of Gate lands and Counterspells to disrupt their plans. Cards like Journey to Nowhere and Guardian of the Guildpact help to remove threats from the board, while Squadron Hawk and Preordain provide card advantage and deck manipulation. The inclusion of Dawnbringer Cleric and Sacred Cat offer some life gain and early defense. The goal is to stall the game until The Modern Age can take over and secure the win.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through the use of removal spells and disruptive cards, while also utilizing Gates cards to ramp up mana and fix colors. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating value through sacrifice effects and card draw. By controlling the board and resources, the deck can outlast opponents and eventually win through attrition. The Gates cards provide flexibility and consistency in mana production, allowing for a smooth curve and powerful plays throughout the game.

The main focus of this deck is to control the opponent through countering spells, removing threats, and disrupting their gameplay. It includes a variety of removal spells, card draw spells, and ways to mill the opponent's deck. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent by efficiently using resources and maintaining control of the battlefield through counterspells and removal. By utilizing the Dimir colors and a mixture of creatures and spells, the deck seeks to establish dominance and outplay the opponent in a Pauper 1 vs 1 format.

This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast-paced aggressive strategy, using low-cost creatures and efficient removal spells to control the board while dealing consistent damage. The focus is on quickly building a strong board presence and applying pressure to the opponent, utilizing cards like Glint Hawk and Kor Skyfisher to maintain card advantage and tempo. The key is to efficiently disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a steady stream of threats, ultimately wearing them down and securing victory through aggression and attrition.

The main focus of this UR Control deck is to control the game through a combination of counterspells, removal, and card draw. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage through cards like Ponder, Lórien Revealed, and Brainstorm. The inclusion of creatures like Azure Fleet Admiral and Murmuring Mystic provides additional threats, while Skred and Lightning Bolt deal with opposing creatures. The deck also includes a mix of lands to support its mana base and provide flexibility in casting spells.

The deck focuses on quickly playing artifacts and enchantments to boost the power of creatures like Ornithopter, Moon-Circuit Hacker, and Myr Enforcer. By using cards like All That Glitters and Metallic Rebuke, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays and efficient mana usage. With a mix of card draw, artifact creatures, and artifact lands, the deck is able to maintain a fast pace and apply pressure on the opponent early in the game.

The deck focuses on quickly flooding the board with artifact creatures and utilizing sacrifice effects to gain advantage. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with cheap, efficient threats like Myr Enforcer and Frogmite while leveraging cards like Deadly Dispute and Reckoner's Bargain for card advantage. The deck also includes burn spells like Galvanic Blast for reach and removal. Mana fixing is provided through artifacts like Chromatic Star and mana lands like Seat of the Synod. Overall, the deck aims to pressure opponents early and maintain card advantage through sacrificing artifacts.

The main concept of this Aggro-Affinity deck is to utilize cheap artifacts like Ichor Wellspring and Myr Enforcer to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a high number of creatures on the battlefield. By sacrificing artifacts like Candy Trail and Deadly Dispute, the deck can generate card advantage and deal damage efficiently. Cards like Krark-Clan Shaman and Metallic Rebuke provide additional removal and control options, while synergies with artifact lands like Vault of Whispers and Seat of the Synod help ramp up the deck's potential. Overall, the deck aims to win by consistently pressuring the opponent with a combination of artifact creatures and removal spells.

The main idea of this deck is to efficiently cycle through cards and fill up your graveyard, using cards like Architects of Will, Street Wraith, and Barren Moor. Once you have enough cards in your graveyard, you can then cast powerful spells like Reaping the Graves and Songs of the Damned to bring back creatures and generate mana for a combo finish with Imposing Vantasaur or Horror of the Broken Lands. Mystical Teachings can be used to find key combo pieces, while Cabal Ritual and Dark Ritual help ramp up your mana production.

The deck focuses on quickly flooding the board with artifact creatures and using cheap spells to draw cards and pump up the creatures for powerful attacks. It aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of evasion, card advantage, and aggressive creatures that can quickly close out the game. With a mix of aggressive creatures, cheap artifacts, and card draw spells, the deck aims to outpace opponents and maintain a strong board presence throughout the game.
